title: Consolidation of DON PMO and ONR SBIR/STTR support with the Small Business Transition Program
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > ONR > ONR HQS > OFFICE OF NAVAL RESEARCH
description:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) - N0001427RFI7002  
  

  Notice Type:  Request for Information 
 
 Title:  Consolidation of DON PMO and ONR SBIR/STTR support with the Small Business Transition Program 
 
 Agency:  Department of the Navy, Office of Naval Research (ONR) 
 
 Point of Contact:  Mary Helen Dent (mary.h.dent.civ@us.navy.mil) 

  
 1. INTRODUCTION  
  

 This RFI is part of a series of RFI and/or RFI/Sources Sought issued by the Government to make strategic acquisition decisions for the Department of Navy and Office of Naval Research SBIR/STTR support office.   

  

 The purpose of this RFI is to seek contractor comments on a possible contract consolidation of multiple requirements for the SBIR/STTR program. 

  

 This RFI is a supplement to another posted RFI/SS under N0001427RFI7001. That RFI/SS seeks to obtain information only on DON PMO and ONR SBIR/STTR support. 

  

  

  2. BACKGROUND AND SCOPE  
  

 Currently, ONR has two separate Navy Seaport Task Orders that support the SBIR/STTR office. 

  

 N0017819D7599 

 N0001422F3000 

 Engineering Services Network (in final option year) 

 N0017819D7112 

 N0001425F3003 

 American Technology Solutions International Corp (In first option year) 

  

 
	 N0001422F3000 currently supports DON PMO and ONR SBIR/STTR support. 
	 N0001425F3003 currently supports the Small Business Transition Program (STP). 
 

 The ONR Services Requirements Review Board (SRRB) has tasked the Program Office and ONR contracting with obtaining vendor comments on a possible consolidation. The responses from vendors will be used in a meeting with the SRRB Board in JAN 2027 when a decision will be made to consolidate the two contracts in the table above OR keep each requirement separate. 

  

 If a consolidation does occur, it is planned that N0001425F3003 will continue for the full 5 years and will merge into the requirement for DON PMO and ONR SBIR/STTR support. 

  

  3. INFORMATION REQUESTED  

  

 Attached to this RFI are: 

  

  

 
	 N0001422F3000 Current Task Order PWS 
	 N0001425F3003 Current Task Order PWS 
 

 Both PWS’s are attached in order to aid in vendor comments. 

  

 Please address the following: 

 
	 From an operational and financial standpoint, what risks and challenges do you foresee if the Government aligns or bridges these timelines into a unified single award? 
	 Does the consolidation of these two task orders present a barrier that would prevent your company from competing as a Prime Contractor? 
	 If this combined requirement is competed, what percentage of the total contract value could realistically be subcontracted to small business concerns across both functional areas? 
	 Does combining these two distinct efforts under a single awardee introduce mission delivery risks (e.g., single-vendor dependency or conflicting priorities)? 
	 What tangible overhead, administrative, or operational cost savings (expressed as percentage or category reductions) can the Government realistically expect by issuing a single consolidated task order? 
	 In addition to the questions above, please address any other benefits, or risks, to consolidation of these two contracts. 
 

  

  4. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS  
  

  Deadline:  Responses are due no later than   Monday, 7 Dec 2026 at 1200 Eastern.     
  

  Page Limit:  Responses shall not exceed 5 pages in length excluding the Cover Sheet. 

  

 Cover Sheet: At a minimum, the Cover Sheet should include the name of the company, POC information to include name/email/phone, and CAGE Code. 
  

  Subject Line:  When submitting, please include “ N0001427RFI7002 (VENDOR NAME)”  in the subject line. 

  

  

  

  

   IMPORTANT NOTICE TO VENDORS: AVOID GENERIC SUBMISSIONS   
The Government will NOT review or evaluate generic, boilerplate Corporate Capability Statements or marketing brochures. The sole purpose of this RFI is to receive direct, specific answers to the information contained herein. Submissions that fail to directly address these specific questions will be discarded without review.
